verificationCode.subject: Verification code for {userName}
verificationCode.intro: To complete your {actionType}, please use the following verification code:
verificationCode.expiration: This code is valid for 24 hours. If you did not request this, you can safely ignore this email.
verificationCode.resetExpiration: This password reset code is valid for 15 minutes. If you did not request it, ignore this email.

tenantInvitation.subject: Invitation to {tenantName}
tenantInvitation.community: Join the team behind this publication and help shape what its audience reads.
tenantInvitation.access: Granted permissions: {scopeCount}. You can review them before accepting.

tenantMemberRemoved.subject: Your access to {tenantName} was removed
tenantMemberRemoved.intro: You no longer have access to this publication or its administration.
tenantMemberRemoved.otherTenants: Your Topiqu account and access to any other publications were not affected.
tenantMemberRemoved.contact: If you believe this was a mistake, contact the publication owner at {ownerEmail}. A new invitation is required to restore access.

userBan.subject: Your account has been banned
userBan.intro_with_reason_permanent: Your account has been banned on the subdomain {clientSiteId} for the following reason: {reason}. This ban is permanent.
userBan.intro_with_reason_temporary: Your account has been banned on the subdomain {clientSiteId} for the following reason: {reason}. The ban is effective until {banDuration}.
userBan.intro_no_reason: Your account has been banned on the subdomain {clientSiteId}.

creditsDepleted.subject: {tenantName} needs more credits
creditsDepleted.preview: Top up credits for the next AI article.
creditsDepleted.intro: {tenantName} does not have enough credits for the next article at the selected quality.
creditsDepleted.paused: New scheduled articles are paused. Automatic writing resumes on schedule once you add enough credits or lower the writing quality.
creditsDepleted.safe: Everything already published, scheduled or saved as a draft stays exactly as it is.
creditsDepleted.footer: We send this once per top-up, so it will not fill your inbox.

articleHeld.subject: An article on {tenantName} is waiting for you
articleHeld.preview: The autopilot held one article back. Review it in a minute.
articleHeld.greeting: An article is waiting for your review
articleHeld.intro: The autopilot finished “{articleTitle}” for {tenantName} but did not publish it.
articleHeld.reason: The editorial check found something it could not fix safely on its own. The editor shows exactly what, and you can publish the article as is with one click.
articleHeld.footer: Your other scheduled articles continue as planned.

accountDeletionConfirm.subject: Confirm deleting your Topiqu account
accountDeletionConfirm.intro: Hi {userName}, someone asked to delete this Topiqu account. Confirm it within one hour to continue.
accountDeletionConfirm.note: If this was not you, ignore this email and nothing will change.

accountDeletionScheduled.subject: Your Topiqu account will be deleted on {deletionDate}
accountDeletionScheduled.greeting: Your account is scheduled for deletion
accountDeletionScheduled.intro: Hi {userName}, your account is deactivated and will be permanently anonymised on {deletionDate}.
accountDeletionScheduled.note: If this was not you, restore the account and change your password.

accountDeletionReminder.subject: Your Topiqu account will be deleted on {deletionDate}
accountDeletionReminder.greeting: Your account will be deleted soon
accountDeletionReminder.intro: Hi {userName}, your account will be permanently anonymised on {deletionDate}. After that it cannot be restored.
accountDeletionReminder.note: If you still want it deleted, you do not need to do anything.

accountDeletionRestored.subject: Your Topiqu account was restored
accountDeletionRestored.intro: Hi {userName}, your account is active again and you can sign in.
accountDeletionRestored.note: Subscriptions that ended in the meantime can be renewed in your blog settings.

accountDeletionBlogClosing.subject: {tenantName} will close on {deletionDate}
accountDeletionBlogClosing.intro: Hi {userName}, the owner of {tenantName} deleted their account, so the blog will close on {deletionDate}.
accountDeletionBlogClosing.note: Save anything you need before then. We will let you know if the closure is cancelled.

accountDeletionBlogKept.subject: {tenantName} will stay open
accountDeletionBlogKept.intro: Hi {userName}, the owner of {tenantName} restored their account, so the blog is no longer closing.

articleBatchFinished.subject: Your article plan for {tenantName} is finished
articleBatchFinished.preview: See what was written and what needs your review.
articleBatchFinished.summary: Waiting for your review: {held}. Could not be written: {failed}. Credits are charged only for finished articles.
articleBatchFinished.footer: You can start another plan whenever you have free credits.
